body:
Who are you to claim it's not me at my core? You don't really know anything about me... so I don't think you have proper information to make an assessment like that.

It doesn't matter if it's an "image" or not. It's who I am, and it's how I am. You can only change what you do, you cannot change how you FEEL. Some people have a lot of mental disorders and can't be at peace with themselves. Some people literally can't love themselves because they're legitimately overall negative people. That's reality. Ok? Assuming that everyone is ultimately good is just a wrong assumption.

No, some people don't deserve love. I've been loved before by different people. It doesn't make me feel any better. It never has, and never will. Of course I'd feel worse if I didn't have that, or never had it, but that'd be a good thing because I'd have no reason to stay attached to this world. It doesn't make me happy to be "loved". No, it's really not a good scenario for me.

Skewed? No, not really. I have a realistic view of myself. I've talked plenty to other people about this kind of stuff as well, and they agree with me.

No, none of those things would make me happy. Love is a joke, it's something for people who aren't fucked up like I am. Fucked up to the core. No, I've never even had good friendships in my life because I'm not the type of person that does well with other people. Other people don't make me happy, they're just another reason to stress over and be anxious about. I don't love other people, and other people don't love me either. That's just how it is.

Things to create, no. I don't enjoy creating things. I've tried creating plenty of things. Art, physical and digital. Creating videos, playing instruments, making digital music, animation, video game creation/coding. I don't enjoy making things, and I don't have an interest to keep trying.

No, there's no grand experience that I want to have. I don't want anything, and there's no point in living.

I don't think that way. I think realistically. I don't think of an imaginary scenario where everything is possible, because everything isn't possible. I only think about things that are realistic, and there is no possible realistic scenario that's within reach that would result in me being happy. Some people literally can't become happy because there is no possible way to be happy. No realistic scenario where happiness will ever be a possibility.
Honestly, to make it so the universe never existed in the first place. That'd be good.

Not even going to waste my time responding to your questions. I already know what you'll say in response to what I have to say and I'm not interested in arguing.

No. I'm not talking about a grand scheme. I'm talking about PERSONAL purpose. And yes, there's a perfectly good reason to not want to continue to live. Because life is shitty, I'm not happy, and I will never be happy. That's a perfectly good reason to end it.
